from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u090/system/state/workspace/programs/task-eab6c819.py')
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    q = (y + dy, x + dx)
                    if 0 <= q[0] < h and 0 <= q[1] < w and q not in seen and grid[q[0]][q[1]] != 0:
                        seen.add(q)
                        stack.append(q)
            marks = [(y, x) for y, x in cells if grid[y][x] == 9]
            if marks:
                ys, xs = [y for y, x in cells], [x for y, x in cells]
                y0, x0 = min(ys), min(xs)
                pts = [(y-y0, x-x0) for y, x in marks]
                diagonal = len(pts) <= 1 or len({x-y for y, x in pts}) == 1 or len({x+y for y, x in pts}) == 1
                objects.append((cells, len(marks), diagonal))
    if objects:
        target = min(objects, key=lambda o: (o[1], not o[2], len(o[0])))
        out = [row[:] for row in grid]
        for y, x in target[0]:
            out[y][x] = 0
        return out
    return [row[:] for row in grid]
'''
p.write_text(code)
print(p)
